git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Handle Ctrl+D (EOF) in interactive prompt loops

In raw mode, Ctrl+D sends byte 0x04 which the console crate maps to
Key::Char('\x04'). The custom prompt_yes_no and prompt_select_dumb
loops had no handler for this key, causing the loop to spin forever
when the user pressed Ctrl+D.

Return an UnexpectedEof IO error when Ctrl+D is detected, matching
the behavior that occurs when read_key() encounters EOF in canonical
mode. Also fix pre-existing clippy warnings (sort_by_key,
collapsible_match, checked_div).
EOF
